name: Delete Important Scheduled Task
description: Detects when adversaries stop services or processes by deleting their respective scheduled tasks in order to conduct data destructive activities
author: GAI_CTI
query: process.executable:*\\schtasks.exe AND (process.command_line:*\/delete* AND process.command_line:*\/tn*) AND (process.command_line:(*\\Windows\\BitLocker* OR *\\Windows\\ExploitGuard* OR *\\Windows\\SystemRestore\\SR* OR *\\Windows\\UpdateOrchestrator\\* OR *\\Windows\\Windows\ Defender\\* OR *\\Windows\\WindowsBackup\\* OR *\\Windows\\WindowsUpdate\\*))
